'''Eberon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> located in the [[Eberon system/Legends|Eberon system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]].<ref name="Online" /> Around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], Eberon was engaged in the [[Eberon–Kashyyyk War]] with the nearby planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], but the conflict was eventually ended by the personal intervention of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
